done_when: Forge runs v1.2.0 and reviews run on GPT-6 Sol at high effort

dismissals.because: forge.toml:2 an upgrade changes only Forge's settings and synced files; Forge's own pull-request check installs and runs the pinned v1.2.0 on this pull request, forge close refuses stale synced files, and Forge's repo tests the review model choice, so an app-side test would only re-test Forge

findings.body: The changed Forge version and review settings have no test in the repository suite. The unchanged `forge.toml:5` test command exits successfully when `package.json` is absent, as it is here. The only repository test, `tests/readme.test.sh:1`, checks README text and is not invoked by that command. The reported green close run would therefore remain green if Forge still ran an older release or reviews used a different model or effort. Add a suite-wired check that exercises the Forge command and review selection and fails when either done-when setting is broken.
findings.title: Not done: test Forge v1.2.0 and GPT-6 Sol high-effort reviews
